Code of the grid square of points

Source: R/grid-code.R
grid_code.Rd

grid_code() gives the code of the grid square (地域メッシュ・コード) that contains each point, for example the sites of land_price_get(). It is the step that assigns every point source to grid squares, so that they join the tables on grid squares and grid_city_get().

Usage

grid_code(x, grid_size = c("500m", "1km"))

Arguments

x

An sf object or sfc of points with longitude and latitude, such as JGD2011 or JGD2000. Their difference is far smaller than a grid square, so the coordinates are used as they are.

grid_size

The size of the grid squares: "500m" (the default) or "1km". Areas of 1 km squares are the sums of the areas of their four 500 m squares. Both are built and cached for a release on the first call.

Value

A character vector of codes, nine digits for 500 m and eight digits for 1 km.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
sites <- land_price_get(2020)
sites$grid_code <- grid_code(sites)
}
